nodes.name: hub
nodes.purpose: This machine. The strongest model: hard coding work, planning, and the fallback when another machine is down.

nodes.name: worker1
nodes.purpose: A second machine for ordinary coding work: bug fixes, small features, running plan steps.

nodes.name: worker2
nodes.purpose: A small, fast model for quick questions and trivial edits.

nodes.name: eyes
nodes.purpose: Reads screenshots and images. Only used when a message contains an image.

run_tests.description: Runs the .NET tests of a project or solution and reports which failed.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Path to the test project, the solution, or its folder

model_fit.description: Estimates whether a model fits a machine and how fast it would run (llmfit plan). Pass the machine's graphics memory, RAM and CPU cores, and a model id from the llmfit catalog; leave the machine out to score this host. Needs llmfit installed (https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit); give the full path to llmfit in the command if it is not on the backend's PATH.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id from the llmfit catalog, for example Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct

parameters.name: vram
parameters.description: The machine's graphics memory with a unit, for example 16G

parameters.name: ram
parameters.description: The machine's system memory with a unit, for example 64G

parameters.name: cores
parameters.description: The machine's CPU core count, for example 16

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Context length in tokens to plan for, for example 16384
